name: hud_ui_numeric_text_input_on_activate
description: HudUiNumericTextInput::OnActivate marks the slider border active and forwards to HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4b4c90 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b4c90 validates sliderBorder.inputActive = 1 followed by a tail jump to HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate.
The native numeric text-input smoke verifies OnActivate sets inputActive on an inactive numeric text input.
